resources.string: Ongoing status while Synco keeps this phone and your Mac on the same clipboard.
Lets Synco read the clipboard while the app is in the background

Android only lets the app holding the current window read the clipboard. When you copy something, Synco briefly adds a tiny invisible window to take input focus for a few milliseconds, reads the clip, then removes it, so a copy you make in any app can reach your Mac. Synco reads only right after a copy and never reads, stores, or sends the contents of any screen.
Progress while a large file moves between your devices.
